issue.title: Withdrawn unacknowledged complaint returns acknowledgement with None and blank deadline
issue.actual: Fresh synthetic complaint9/CMP-2026-00008 was received through the real Quality UI and withdrawn before acknowledgement. Current GET /complaints/9 is200 Withdrawn with acknowledged_at/contact_name null. GET /complaints/9/letter/print-payload?letter=Acknowledgement nevertheless answers200 with 'Your contact person at the hospital: None.', 'What we will do: None', and 'We will tell you the outcome by , or let you know if we need more time.' Urdu also contains None and a blank deadline. This reads like an investigation promise despite no acknowledgement and a recorded withdrawal. GET did not mutate the complaint; no state mutation or frontend print defect is alleged.
issue.expected: get_endpoint for the letter operation documents409 COMPLAINT_STATE_INVALID when the complaint has not reached that letter's step (example: acknowledgement before acknowledgement). Please enforce that for a complaint withdrawn before acknowledgement, or explicitly define a separate valid withdrawal/receipt letter that omits absent fields and does not promise an investigation/deadline. The frontend currently offers acknowledgement letters only when acknowledged_at exists and does not rewrite backend paragraphs.
